Let \(b_n=\frac1{a_n}\). Then

\[
b_{n+1}=\frac1{a_{n+1}}
=\frac1{a_n}-\frac1{a_n+2018}
=b_n-\frac1{a_n+2018}.
\]

For \(i\le k\), we have \(0<a_i<1\), so

\[
\frac1{2019}<\frac1{a_i+2018}<\frac1{2018}.
\]

Since \(a_k<1<a_{k+1}\), we have \(b_k>1>b_{k+1}\). Thus

\[
b_k=2-\sum_{i=0}^{k-1}\frac1{a_i+2018}>1
\]

so

\[
\sum_{i=0}^{k-1}\frac1{a_i+2018}<1.
\]

Using the lower bound,

\[
\frac{k}{2019}<1 \implies k<2019.
\]

Also,

\[
b_{k+1}=2-\sum_{i=0}^{k}\frac1{a_i+2018}<1
\]

so

\[
\sum_{i=0}^{k}\frac1{a_i+2018}>1.
\]

Using the upper bound,

\[
\frac{k+1}{2018}>1 \implies k+1>2018 \implies k\ge 2018.
\]

Therefore \(k=2018\).

\[
\boxed{2018}
\]
